name: NIST Privacy Framework: A Tool for Improving Privacy through Enterprise Risk Management
description: The NIST Privacy Framework v1.0 (Jan 16, 2020) is a voluntary US enterprise privacy-risk-management tool organized as 5 Functions (Identify-P, Govern-P, Control-P, Communicate-P, Protect-P), 18 Categories, and 100 Subcategories addressing privacy risks arising from data processing. Version 1.1 was released as an Initial Public Draft on April 14, 2025 (comment period closed June 13, 2025) and remained in draft as of June 2026, so v1.0 is the current finalized version. AGENT-RESPONSIBILITY-BOUNDARY CAVEAT: most subcategories are organization-wide privacy-program outcomes; AKSI mappings cover onl
jurisdiction: United States (NIST voluntary framework; used globally, sector-agnostic)
